user_correction: Use visibly larger fish and less similar scenes; reject hundreds of kbps; preserve original frame rate and allow modest spatial downsampling.
historical_run: D2_20261021_r1 remains a high-rate diagnostic, not an application-compliant result.

selection.basis: Consecutive annotated windows ranked by mean largest-instance area, then source-only representative images for distinct backgrounds; no codec or predicted-quality selection.

delivery.frame_rate: Original verified PTS; no frame dropping or duration inflation
delivery.spatial_selection: Largest common ladder resolution with ordinary A@q0 <=40000 bit/s for both clips; measure actual complete files. Stop at 320x180 if none fits.
delivery.resize: Pillow LANCZOS; all methods share identical resized source RGB, dimensions, timeline, GOP and reset

budget.S0: A@q0 at the selected common resolution, frozen before B/C results
budget.counted: complete glcv plus required per-clip side information; sender-only masks are not transmitted
budget.over_limit_policy: retain diagnostic record only; never present as a compliant delivery

codec.rate_selection: A and B seek largest file below effective ceiling; C seeks largest file below min(selected A bytes, selected B bytes). q0 first, next q by log-size interpolation or initial slope .016 per q, then measured log slope; clamp to unevaluated integer bracket 0..63. Stop once within 2% from below or after four measured points.
codec.unmatched: Report actual byte gaps and insufficient matching; no expansion
codec.independent_decode: Only selected compliant points, in receiver processes without source/GT inputs

methods.A: Resized source RGB plus ordinary GLC
methods.B: Whole-frame Gaussian low-pass, sigma=1.2 encoded pixels, float32 reflect truncate4, uint8 rounding, then GLC
methods.C: Frozen predicted protection retains A input in its core; identical B low-pass outside, then GLC
methods.O: Not run in this bounded pilot

semantics.fish: original RGB native tiles512 stride384, mean logits, class6 probability >=0.5
semantics.diver: same existing model, longedge256 letterbox, argmax class1 and probability >=0.5
semantics.protection: union, original 16px-at1920 dilation, previous one raw seed, original 4px-at1920 soft edge and existing fallback; resize saved alpha NEAREST to delivery size

evaluation.primary: Independent decoded PNG versus identical pre-semantic resized source RGB; GT mask resized NEAREST, all fish including misses; pooled SSE then PSNR
evaluation.secondary: Decoded RGB upsampled LANCZOS to original size against original publisher RGB/GT; report separately, never compare low-resolution PSNR directly to old 1080p PSNR
evaluation.semantic_claim: Requires actual size disclosure and improvement versus both A and B; no assumed visible advantage
evaluation.viewing: Labeled original/A/B/C at common time and scale, full frame plus fixed source-GT-selected fish crop; optional hide labels, not forced blind guessing
evaluation.preview_bytes: Viewing MP4 is a local display artifact; transmitted bytes are the glcv, shown explicitly
evaluation.continuous_visual_acceptance: user assessment pending, no automatic pass
